form.label: NX-OS Security Compliance
form.description: Device compliance grades, severity breakdown, and per-check drilldown from the NX-OS Compliance Checker (NDJSON).

search.query: index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_summary | stats count by hostname
index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_summary hostname=$host_tok$ | stats dc(hostname)
index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_summary hostname=$host_tok$ | stats latest(percentage) as pct by hostname | stats avg(pct) as avg | eval avg=round(avg,1)
index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_check status=FAIL severity=CRITICAL hostname=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_summary hostname=$host_tok$ | stats latest(grade) as grade by hostname | stats count by grade | sort grade

index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_check status=FAIL hostname=$host_tok$ | stats count by severity | eval order=case(severity="CRITICAL",1,severity="HIGH",2,severity="MEDIUM",3,severity="LOW",4) | sort order | fields - order
index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_check status=FAIL hostname=$host_tok$ | chart count over hostname by severity

index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_summary hostname=$host_tok$ | stats latest(grade) as Grade latest(percentage) as Score latest(passed) as Pass latest(failed) as Fail by hostname | rename hostname as Device | sort - Fail
index=dcn-compliance sourcetype=nxos_compliance event_type=compliance_check status=FAIL hostname="$drill_host$" | table check_id category severity description message remediation | sort severity
